description: Check from a screenshot that expected text is really visible to a user (not just in the DOM). Runs local OCR, offline. Returns pass/fail, what was read, confidence and, on failure, the reason (NOT_FOUND, LOW_CONFIDENCE, INSUFFICIENT_CONTRAST) and where on the screenshot. Use it after changing UI to confirm the change rendered.

exact.description: Require the region text to equal the expected text

expected.description: The text a user should be able to read

image_base64.description: Base64 PNG or JPEG, if there is no file path

image_path.description: Path to a PNG or JPEG screenshot on this machine

region.description: Only read this part of the screenshot (pixels from the top-left corner)

name: verify_text
title: Verify text is visible on screen
